articles.headline: WEBTOON (NASDAQ:WBTN) reports sales below analyst estimates in Q3 2026 earnings
articles.summary: WEBTOON reported Q3 2026 revenue of $362.8 million, representing a 4% year-on-year decline and missing Wall Street expectations. Adjusted earnings per share came in at $0.02, beating the consensus estimate of $0.01. Adjusted EBITDA reached $2.21 million, which was below the $4.12 million estimate. For Q4 2026, management guided revenue to a midpoint of $376 million and EBITDA to $2.5 million. Monthly active users rose to 159 million, and market capitalization stood at $1.31 billion.
articles.summary_zh: 数字故事平台WEBTOON公布2026年第三季度营收为$362.8 million，同比下降4%，低于华尔街预期。 经调整每股收益为$0.02，超出分析师预期的$0.01。 经调整EBITDA为$2.21 million，低于分析师预期的$4.12 million。 对于2026年第四季度，管理层预计营收中位数为$376 million，EBITDA中位数为$2.5 million。 月度活跃用户增至159 million，市值达$1.31 billion。

articles.headline: SSE Composite Today: Shanghai Edges Up 0.32% to 3,660.79 as Coal Stocks Rally and Turnover Thins
articles.summary: China's Shanghai Composite Index closed up 11.61 points or 0.32% at 3,660.79 on Monday, November 9, 2026, recovering part of the previous session's 1.10% decline. Coal miners and aircraft makers led gains, while lithium and solar stocks fell. Combined turnover on the Shanghai and Shenzhen exchanges dropped to about 1.48 trillion yuan, roughly $222 billion, down 175.2 billion yuan from the previous session. Investors reacted to softer domestic October consumer inflation data, reports of an extended US-China trade truce, and Nvidia investigating its CEO.
articles.summary_zh: 2026年11月9日星期一，中国上证综指收盘上涨11.61点，涨幅0.32%，报3,660.79点，收复了上一交易日下跌1.10%的部分失地。 煤炭开采和飞机制造股领涨，而锂电池和太阳能股票下跌。 沪深两市成交额降至约1.48 trillion yuan（约合$222 billion），较上一交易日减少175.2 billion yuan。 投资者对国内10月消费通胀数据放缓、美中贸易休战期延长的报道以及英伟达对其首席执行官进行调查的消息作出了反应。

articles.headline: Tesla Soars 5% as Robotaxi Reaches San Antonio and Cybertruck Order Rate “Far Exceeds” Production
articles.summary: Tesla shares rose 5% after its robotaxi service expanded to San Antonio, making it the seventh robotaxi city. Elon Musk stated that Cybertruck orders far exceed production and announced plans to wind down Cybertruck production around mid-2027 to prioritize Cybercabs, while refunding unfillable deposits. The company delivered 8,295 vehicles in its 'other models' line in the third quarter. Meanwhile, Tesla's operating margin fell to 2.6% in the third quarter of 2026 from 16.8% in 2022.
articles.summary_zh: 特斯拉股价上涨5%，其自动驾驶出租车服务已拓展至圣安东尼奥，使其成为第七个机器人出租车城市。 埃隆·马斯克表示，Cybertruck的订单远超生产速度，并宣布计划在2027年中期左右逐步停止Cybertruck生产以优先制造Cybercabs，同时将退还无法满足的订金。 该公司在第三季度“其他车型”系列中共交付了8,295辆汽车。 与此同时，特斯拉的营业利润率从2022年的16.8%降至2026年第三季度的2.6%。

articles.headline: Alphabet (GOOGL) Stock Quotes, Company News And Chart Analysis
articles.summary: Advanced Micro Devices announced on Monday that its fifth-generation Epyc server processors will power Alphabet's Google Cloud TPU 8tx.
articles.summary_zh: 超威半导体于周一宣布，其第五代Epyc服务器处理器将为Alphabet的Google Cloud TPU 8tx提供动力。

articles.headline: Stock Market Today: Stock Market News And Analysis
articles.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average soared more than 1,100 points on Monday, driven by rallies in Amazon and Tesla, while Nvidia shares declined. Futures for major stock indexes traded little changed ahead of Tuesday's open, as markets awaited the CPI inflation report.
articles.summary_zh: 受亚马逊和特斯拉上涨推动，道琼斯工业平均指数周一飙升逾1,100点，而英伟达股价下跌。 在周二开盘前，主要股指期货变动不大，市场正等待CPI通胀报告。

articles.headline: Strength in Tech and Weakness in Crude Oil Boost Stocks
articles.summary: US stock indices climbed sharply, driven by dip buying in chipmakers, AI-infrastructure stocks, and the Magnificent Seven technology stocks. Meanwhile, WTI crude oil fell more than -3% due to diplomatic efforts regarding Iran and President Trump's remarks stating that additional strikes are unlikely if peace talks progress. Concurrently, Nvidia shares dropped over -5% following an internal investigation into CEO Huang. In economic data, S&P 500 Q3 earnings are expected to grow by +31% year-over-year, and Treasury yields fell as WTI crude price drops eased inflation expectations.
articles.summary_zh: 美国股市主要指数大幅上涨，主要受到投资者对芯片制造商、AI基础设施股以及“七巨头”科技股的逢低买入支撑。 与此同时，由于针对伊朗的外交努力持续推进，且美国总统特朗普表示若和平谈判取得进展则“极不可能”对伊朗实施更多打击，WTI原油价格下跌超过-3%。 另一方面，英伟达股价下跌超过-5%，此前该公司董事会对其首席执行官黄仁勋展开了调查。 在经济数据方面，标普500指数第三季度盈利预计将同比增长+31%，而随着WTI原油价格下跌缓解了通胀预期，美国国债收益率有所下降。

articles.headline: 日経平均株価、米AI株持ち直しが支えに（先読み株式相場）
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: On December 10, the Tokyo stock market's Nikkei Stock Average is expected to continue rising, supported by a rebound in US semiconductor and artificial intelligence (AI) stocks that has improved investor sentiment. The Nikkei is projected to gain over 1000 yen from the previous close of 5万8775円, aiming to recover the 6万円 milestone. In the US market on December 9, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rebounded significantly by 1104 dollars or 2.15% to close at 5万2389ドル.
articles.summary_zh: 10日的东京股市中，日经平均株価预计将继续上涨，其受到美国半导体及人工智能（AI）股票回升的支撑，投资者的心理有所改善。 日经平均指数预计较前一交易日收盘价（5万8775円）上涨超过1000日元，并朝收复6万日元大关迈进。 在9日的美国股市中，道琼斯工业平均指数大幅反弹，较前一个交易日上涨1104美元（2.15%），收于5万2389美元。

articles.headline: 今日の株価材料（新聞など、10日）JX金属の純利益53%増 27年3月期
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: JX Metals announced a 53% increase in net income for the fiscal year ending March 2027, with the company citing that AI demand is not slowing down. Additionally, JX Metals has taken a stake of over 7% in optical components maker Oxide to target the AI and quantum sectors. Meanwhile, SoftBank Group's net income for the fiscal year ending March 2027 is expected to rise by 11%, driven by stock sale gains and a strong financial business performance.
articles.summary_zh: JX金属公布截至2027年3月期的纯利润将增长53%，并表示“AI需求未减速”。 此外，JX金属对光学元件制造商オキサイド出资超过7%，瞄准AI与量子领域。 同时，软银集团截至2027年3月期的纯利润预计上调至增长11%，主要受益于股票出售收益以及金融业务表现良好。

articles.headline: ドールが決算 コスト上昇が利益圧迫 株価は小幅高に転じる＝米国株個別(株探ニュース)
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: Dole reported its Q3 results before the market opened, revealing that earnings per share fell significantly short of expectations while revenue was slightly below forecasts, pressured by rising costs. In Europe, increased bunker fuel costs are expected to generate an additional burden of approximately $16 million compared to initial assumptions. Dole reported Q3 adjusted earnings per share of $0.16 against an estimated $0.32, and revenue of $2.37 billion. Adjusted EBITDA reached $84.1 million, and the company revised its full-year adjusted EBITDA guidance to a range of $3.80 to $3.90 billion.
articles.summary_zh: 都乐在交易开始前公布了第三季度财报，由于成本上升挤压了利润，每股收益远低于预期，而营收也略低于预测。 在欧洲，由于船舶燃料费用上涨，预计将产生比最初设想增加约1600万美元的额外负担。 都乐公布的第三季度调整后每股收益为0.16美元（预期为0.32美元），营收为23.7亿美元。 调整后EBITDA为8410万美元，公司并将全年调整后EBITDA预期下修至3.80亿至3.90亿美元。

articles.headline: 任天堂、売上高12.1%減でも営業利益は49.1%増。Nintendo Switch 2のハードウェア販売台数は649万台、通期予想は据え置き（LIMO）
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: Nintendo released its interim financial results for the fiscal year ending March 2027, reporting a 12.1% decrease in net sales to 9660亿4100万円 and a 49.1% increase in operating income to 2165億円, alongside increases in ordinary and net income. While Nintendo Switch 2 hardware sales dropped to 6.49 million units from the post-launch period last year, software sales remained robust with strong titles such as Splatoon Raiders, Star Fox, and Fire Emblem. Additionally, digital sales grew by 60.5% to 2496億円, and IP-related revenues surged by 87.9% to 627億円.
articles.summary_zh: 任天堂发布了截至2027年3月期中间期（2026年4月至9月）财报，受硬件销量下降影响，销售额同比减少12.1%至9660亿4100万円，但得益于软件销售稳健及美国IEEPA关税退税，营业利润大幅增长49.1%至2165億円，经常利润与中间纯利润也实现增长。 Nintendo Switch 2硬件销量为649万台，低于去年同期刚发售时的1036万台，但软件销量上升，总毛利率从约36%上升至约50%。 此外，数字销售额增长60.5%至2496億円，IP相关收入等增长87.9%至627億円。

articles.headline: 【見通し】株式明日の戦略ー4桁上昇も後場は伸び悩む、戻り局面ではTOPIX優位となる可能性
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: 9日の日経平均は6日ぶり大幅反発し、終値は1340円高の58775円となった。 米国市場でのハイテク株高を背景に、前営業日の大幅下落の反動から買いが広がり、前引けには上げ幅が2000円を超えた。 しかし後場は伸び悩み、59000円を下回る水準で取引を終えた。 東証プライムの売買代金は概算で8兆9100億円。 業種別ではその他製品、銀行、輸送用機器などが上昇した一方、食料品と海運の2業種のみが下落した。 通期の利益見通しを引き上げたセカンドリテイリングがストップ高となった半面、決算を控えたソフトバンクグループは4.2％安となった。 米10月雇用統計を受けた早期利上げへの意識から銀行株が大幅上昇し、トヨタなどの自動車株も買いを集めた。 日経平均は2.3％高だったがTOPIXは3.0％高となり、TOPIX優位の地合いが見られた。
articles.summary_zh: 9日日本日经平均指数迎来6个交易日以来的首次大幅反弹，收盘上涨1340円至58775円。 受美国市场科技股走强提振，加上前一交易日大幅下跌后的反动买盘推动，早盘涨幅一度超过2000円。 但午后涨势放缓，收盘跌破59000円。 东证主板市场的成交额估算为8兆9100億円。 行业方面，其他产品、银行、运输用设备等大幅上涨，仅食品和海运两个行业下跌。 上调全期利润预期的赛克兰零售涨停，而即将公布财报软银集团则下跌4.25%。 受美国10月就业报告引发的加息预期影响，三菱UFJ和瑞穗FG等银行股大涨，丰田等汽车股也受到追捧。 日经平均指数上涨2.3%，东证指数上涨3.0%，市场呈现东证指数占优的格局。

articles.headline: 決算:ソフトバンク純利益11％増に上振れ 27年3月期、株売却益や金融事業好調
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: ソフトバンクグループの国内通信子会社ソフトバンクは9日、2027年3月期の連結純利益が前期比11%増の6100億円になる見通しだと発表した。 従来予想から500億円の上方修正となり、純利益は2年連続で最高益を更新する。 売上高は12%増の7兆9000億円、営業利益は11%増の1兆1600億円を見込む。 PayPayなどのファイナンス事業の決済取扱高が想定を上回り、先行投資や研究開発費の抑制も利益を押し上げる。 SBエナジー株をソフトバンク・ビジョン・ファンドに売却し、2026年7~9月期に約800億円の売却益を計上したことも寄与する。 宮川潤一社長は決算説明会で、29年3月期の目標だった純利益6000億円を2年前倒しで達成できそうだと説明した。 同時に発表した2026年4~9月期の連結決算は、純利益が前年同期比5%増の3645億円、売上高が12%増の3兆7987億円だった。
articles.summary_zh: 软银集团旗下的日本国内通信子公司软银于9日宣布，预计2027年3月期的合并净利润将比上一期增长11%至6100億円。 较此前预期上调500億円，净利润将连续两年创下历史新高。 预计销售额将增长12%至7兆9000億円，营业利润将增长11%至1兆1600億円。 以PayPay为代表的金融业务结算额超出预期，加之对前期投资和研发费用的控制，共同推高了利润。 将SB Energy股份出售给软银愿景基金并在2026年7至9月期计入约800億円出售收益，也对增益作出了贡献。 社长宫川润一在财报说明会上表示，原定于2029年3月期实现6000亿元净利润的目标有望提前两年达成。 同日公布的2026年4至9月期合并财报显示，净利润较去年同期增长5%至3645億円，销售额增长12%至3兆7987億円。

articles.headline: Bitcoin and Gold Have Never Been the Two Worst Major Assets in the Same Year Until 2026. Why Are Both Store-of-Value Assets Falling?
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Bitcoin and gold are the two worst-performing major assets of 2026, a phenomenon market analyst Charlie Bilello noted has never occurred before in any calendar year. Bitcoin trades at $75,034, down 1.4% over 24 hours and 14.3% this year, sitting 40.5% below its all-time high of $126,080 from October 6, 2025. Higher 10-year Treasury yields, a surging U. S. dollar, and speculative money flowing into AI stocks have pulled capital away from non-yielding stores of value like Bitcoin and gold. Additionally, U. S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $1.28 billion in net outflows between November 2 and November 6, creating direct selling pressure. Gold traded at $4,056 on November 8, 26.5% below its peak of $5,518 on January 28, 2026, reflecting profit-taking after a historic rally. Bitcoin trades below its 20-day and 50-day averages but remains 2.5% above its 200-day average of $73,177. Meanwhile, Ethereum and Solana also declined, while some gold-backed tokens started to show signs of recovery.
articles.summary_zh: Bitcoin和黄金是2026年表现最差的两大主要资产，市场分析师Charlie Bilello指出这是历年从未出现过的现象。 Bitcoin交易价格为$75,034，24小时内下跌1.4%，今年以来下跌14.3%，较2025年10月6日创下的$126,080历史最高点下跌了40.5%。 更高的10年期国债收益率、强劲的美元以及流入人工智能股票的投机资金，将资金从Bitcoin和黄金等不产生收益的价值储存资产中抽离。 此外，美国现货BitcoinETF在11月2日至11月6日期间遭遇了$1.28 billion的净流出，造成了直接的抛售压力。 黄金在11月8日的交易价格为$4,056，较2026年1月28日$5,518的峰值下跌了26.5%，反映出在经历历史性涨势后的获利回吐。 Bitcoin交易价格低于其20日和50日均线，但仍比其$73,177的200日均线高出2.5%。 同时，Ethereum和Solana也有所下跌，而部分黄金支持的代币开始显现复苏迹象。

articles.headline: Global Markets Outlook: Oil Retreat Fuels Pre-CPI Recovery
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Global markets attempted to stabilize following the previous week's technology sell-off, aided by falling crude oil prices as President Donald Trump downplayed the likelihood of renewed strikes on Iran. European trading saw the STOXX 600, FTSE 100, and DAX each rise approximately 0.3%, while France’s CAC 40 dipped 0.1%. The 10-year Treasury yield hovered near 4.84%. In Canada, the S&P/TSX Composite rose 1.3% as mining gains outweighed oil declines. Currency markets showed the euro and sterling gaining while the dollar slipped slightly against the Japanese yen. In employment data, the U. S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that October nonfarm payrolls increased by 165,000, and the unemployment rate held at 4.1%. In China, the National Bureau of Statistics reported that October consumer prices rose 0.7% year-on-year, with food prices falling 2.9% and nonfood prices rising 1.5%. Markets awaited the U. S. October CPI report scheduled for Tuesday.
articles.summary_zh: 在全球市场试图从上周的科技股抛售潮中企稳之际，由于美国总统唐纳德·特朗普淡化了对伊朗再次打击的可能性导致原油价格下跌，市场得到了一定缓解。 欧洲股市方面，斯托克600指数、富时100指数和德国DAX指数均上涨约0.3%，法国CAC 40指数下跌0.1%。 10年期国债收益率维持在4.84%附近。 在加拿大，标普/多伦多综合指数上涨1.3%，矿业股的涨幅超过了石油股的跌幅。 外汇市场上，欧元和英镑走高，美元对日元小幅走低。 就业数据方面，美国劳工统计局报告称，10月非农就业人口增加165,000人，失业率保持在4.1%不变。 在中国，国家统计局报告称，10月居民消费价格同比上涨0.7%，其中食品价格下降2.9%，非食品价格上涨1.5%。 市场正等待定于周二公布的美国10月CPI报告。

articles.headline: Bitcoin millionaire: why 0.3 BTC could be enough
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: According to UBS’s Global Wealth Report 2026, there were approximately 57.5 million U. S. dollar millionaires worldwide at the end of 2025, while Capgemini counts around 25.3 million based on investable assets. Dividing the maximum supply cap of 21 million bitcoin by the UBS figure yields roughly 0.37 BTC per millionaire, or about 0.35 BTC based on the 20.1 million coins mined to date. On November 1, 2026, with Bitcoin priced at $77,683 or €69,362, 0.3 BTC cost approximately $23,300 or €20,800, and 0.1 BTC cost about $7,770. While Bitcoin reached an all-time high of around $126,000 on October 6, 2025, analysts suggest that owning 0.3 BTC could provide millionaire-equivalent wealth in the future if Bitcoin becomes widely adopted as global money. Platforms like Bitpanda and Bitget facilitate purchasing cryptocurrencies, and aiming for 0.1 BTC is presented as a realistic goal for retail investors seeking long-term value.
articles.summary_zh: 根据瑞银2026年全球财富报告，截至2025年底，全球约有5750万名美元百万富翁，而凯捷根据可投资资产计算的数量约为2530万。 将21限额万枚Bitcoin的最大供应量除以瑞银的数据，每个百万富翁大约可分得0.37 BTC，若按迄今已开采的2010万枚计算则约为0.35 BTC。 在2026年11月1日，Bitcoin价格为$77,683或€69,362时，0.3 BTC的成本约为$23,300或€20,800，0.1 BTC约为$7,770。 虽然Bitcoin曾在2025年10月6日达到约$126,000的历史最高点，但分析认为，如果Bitcoin未来成为全球货币，拥有0.3 BTC即可提供相当于百万富翁的财富。 Bitpanda和Bitget等平台简化了加密货币的购买流程，而对寻求长期价值的散户投资者而言，将0.1 BTC作为目标被认为是一个现实可行的目标。

articles.headline: Weekly market commentary
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: BlackRock held its 2027 Forum during the U. S. midterms, where portfolio managers debated the ongoing AI buildout, demand, adoption, and rising competition for capital among government borrowing, energy, and defense. Following a Democratic sweep of Congress, U. S. stocks fell sharply after a brief post-midterm rally, with the Nasdaq entering correction territory. Amid ongoing uncertainty regarding the speed and size of the AI infrastructure expansion, BlackRock shifted its stance to neutral on U. S. equities and upgraded U. S. Treasuries last month, while awaiting upcoming CPI and PPI data ahead of the Federal Reserve's December meeting.
articles.summary_zh: 贝莱德在美国中期选举期间举行了2027年论坛，投资组合经理们就人工智能基础设施建设、需求、普及情况以及政府借债、能源和国防之间日益激烈的资金竞争展开了辩论。 在民主党赢得国会控制权后，美国股市在短暂的中期选举后反弹随即大幅下跌，纳斯达克指数进入修正区间。 鉴于人工智能基础设施扩张的速度和规模仍存在不确定性，贝莱德上个月将美国股票评级下调至中性并上调了美国国债评级，同时在美联储12月会议之前等待即将发布的CPI和PPI数据。

articles.headline: Japanese Yen strengthens as US Dollar gives back part of its post-NFP gains
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: The USD/JPY pair traded under pressure at around 157.91, down 0.36% for the day, as the Japanese Yen found support from a broadly weaker US Dollar. Declining oil prices, with WTI dropping over 3% to around $86 a barrel following comments by US President Donald Trump downplaying fresh strikes on Iran, helped contain US Treasury yields, with the 10-year yield falling 0.33% to 4.83%. The US Dollar Index hovered near 101.80 after October Nonfarm Payrolls increased by 165K and the Unemployment Rate eased to 4.1%. Meanwhile, the Bank of Japan left its policy rate at 1.25% in October, though board member Hajime Takata favoured a rise to 1.50% and Governor Kazuo Ueda warned inflation could exceed the 2% target. Additionally, Japan's Finance Ministry reported a record single-day intervention of purchasing ¥7.98 trillion worth of Yen on July 30.
articles.summary_zh: 美元兑日元汇率在周初承受压力，交投于157.91附近，日内下跌0.36%，日元受到普遍走弱的美元支撑。 由于美国总统唐纳德·特朗普淡化了对伊朗进行新打击的可能性，WTI原油价格下跌超过3%至每桶86美元附近，压低了美国国债收益率，其中10年期美债收益率下跌0.33%至4.83%。 在10月非农就业人口增加165K且失业率降至4.1%之后，美元指数徘徊在101.80附近。 与此同时，日本央行在10月份维持1.25%的政策利率不变，不过董事会成员高田创倾向于将利率提高至1.50%，行长植田和男则警告称通胀可能超过2%的目标。 此外，日本财务省报告称，当局曾在7月30日单日创纪录地买入了价值¥7.98 trillion的日元。

articles.headline: Bitcoin, tech stocks brush off Nvidia nerves as analyst mulls $68K target
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Bitcoin returned above $75,000 after Wall Street's Monday open, bouncing from 11-week lows of $73,500 as investors added tech-stock exposure. Tech stocks and the broader markets moved past controversy surrounding Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, whose stock fell about 6% to $170.24 in early trading before rebounding to $179.92, following claims that he may have been the target of a Chinese intelligence effort, which Beijing denied. Dan Ives of Yorkville Ives & Co. warned of lasting headwinds, while former SEC chair Gary Gensler noted Nvidia's board faces tough choices. Meanwhile, falling oil prices—with US WTI crude dropping to $86.19 per barrel before recovering to $88.20—supported equities and provided relief to Bitcoin. Analyst Keith Alan eyed a potential dip toward the 200-week simple moving average at $67,755, and CoinGlass reported 24-hour crypto liquidations at $1.2 billion.
articles.summary_zh: 比特币在华尔街周一开盘后重返75,000美元上方，随着投资者增加科技股敞口，比特币从11周低点73,500美元反弹。 科技股和更广泛的市场走出了关于英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋的争议阴影，此前有报道称他可能是中国情报工作目标的指控（北京对此予以否认），英伟达股价在早盘下跌约6%至170.24美元，随后反弹至179.92美元。 Yorkville Ives & Co. 的丹·艾夫斯警告称这将带来持久的阻力，而前美国证交会主席加里·根斯勒指出英伟达董事会将面临艰难抉择。 与此同时，下跌的油价（美国WTI原油跌至每桶86.19美元后回升至88.20美元）支撑了股市并缓解了比特币的下行压力。 分析师基思·阿伦指出价格可能向67,755美元的200周简单移动平均线回落，CoinGlass报告24小时加密货币清算额达到12亿美元。

articles.headline: Yen Struggles to Regain Its Safe-Haven Status. Forecast as of 09.11.2026
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Speculators in the USD/JPY market engaged in volatile trading following expectations of monetary tightening by the Bank of Japan and shifts in US policy. Although the Bank of Japan raised its overnight rate to 1.25% and Governor Kazuo Ueda acknowledged that inflation reached the 2% target while cautioning about the duration, Japan's nominal wages rose at their fastest pace in three decades, climbing 4.6% year over year in September, with base wages up 3.7% and wages excluding bonuses and overtime hitting a historic gain of 3.1%. Goldman Sachs views the yen as a hedge against AI market shocks, while CIBC Capital Markets forecasts USD/JPY to slide to 148 by the end of 2027. Near-term direction for the pair depends on upcoming US inflation data, with strong figures potentially pushing the pair toward 160.4 and weaker readings triggering a drop below 157.1.
articles.summary_zh: 美元兑日元市场的投机者在预期日本央行收紧货币政策和美国政策转变后经历了剧烈波动的交易。 尽管日本央行将隔夜利率提高至1.25%，且行长植田和男承认通胀已达到2%的目标但对持续时间保持谨慎，但日本9月份的名义工资以30年来最快速度增长，同比攀升4.6%，其中基础工资上涨3.7%，不含奖金和加班费的工资创下3.1%的历史性涨幅。 高盛将日元视为对冲人工智能市场冲击的工具，而加拿大帝国商业银行资本市场部预测美元兑日元将在2027年底滑落至148。 该货币对的近期走势取决于即将发布的美国通胀数据，强劲的数据可能推动该汇率向160.4迈进，而较弱的数据则可能引发跌破157.1的行情。
